scenario: AITA for cancelling on a date for being tired? | Probably petty but interested in response. I haven’t received a response. Now I think after him thinking I wanted out of the relationship plus now cancelling the date he thinks I’m not interested anymore. AITA for rescheduling a date when he already has doubts about me?
